hypothesis: A causal rolling rank of symbols and frozen sectors may reduce exposure to persistently weak parts of the Flat v7.2 signal universe without using future outcomes or hand-picking winners.

ranking_contract.availability_rule: a shadow outcome is usable only when exit_time <= current entry_time
ranking_contract.symbol_percentile: cross-sectional percentile among symbols with enough completed history
ranking_contract.sector_percentile: mean percentile across the symbol's frozen sector tags
ranking_contract.hybrid_percentile: mean of available symbol and sector percentiles

candidates.name: RANK_HYBRID_BOTTOM_QUARTILE_GATE
candidates.hard_gate: only when a non-missing hybrid percentile is below 0.25

development_gate.selection_rule: At most one passing candidate: highest pooled PF, then lowest DD, then highest positive-fold percentage, then most trades, then name.

anti_overfit_rules: No candidate additions or coefficient changes after viewing results.
No external holdout access unless exactly one candidate passes development.
Blocked candidates are not rescued by manual symbol exclusions.
If all candidates block, proceed to separately preregistered LONG/SHORT regime families.
next_action: Implement and run exactly the control plus four active ranking candidates.
